teacher_info.introduction:
Hello everybody, my name is Andrea and I am an Italian and English tutor.

What can you expect during my lessons in addition to a relaxed and fun environment?

The first lesson is important in order to assess your level and your goals. In general, I stress on conversation because I think that talking is probably the best way to improve since you are exposed to the language and gives you confidence over time.

Making mistakes is "more than welcome"! I will usually correct you at the end of the sentence without interrupting you while you're speaking. 
I usually use materials such as specific documents based on what you want to talk about and articles to read in order to improve your pronunciation, learn new words and discuss new topics.

Furthermore, we can focus on grammar as well. If needed, I will explain you a specific grammar topic you are struggling with and I will provide you with some exercises to do together or on your own.

Finally, I can also help you with your pronunciation and writing skills.

If requested by the student, I can give homework to do for the following lesson. This might include grammar exercises but also a video/article comprehension or also writing about a specific topic so that I can check your writing skills.

I really hope to see you soon, don't hesitate to contact me for any question you might have!

For more tips, this is my Instagram page: https://www.instagram.com/italian_made_simple/

course_info.trial_description:
Hi!
This is a trial lesson for any target audience: getting to know each other is the best way to break the ice and avoid an unpleasant impact with learning.

In this first 45-minute meeting we will discuss your goals, background, and the environment in which you need to practise your English. I will also tell you about my relationship with English, how I got hooked, and the strengths of this language!

We will discuss the learning approach according to your needs, and try to draw up a plan that can foster continuity - while remaining flexible. 

Bye!

pro_course_detail.title: Let's get to know each other: conversation class
pro_course_detail.description:
This is a lesson for those who want to improve their spoken English.

The approach is very different from those who want to learn from a school-related perspective. 

Since we do not have a clear starting point - as is often the case with school material - we will talk about our background: What role does English play in your life? What do you expect from learning this language? How do you think it can change the life of someone who decides to interface with another language, and consequently, other cultures? 

But we will also talk about aspects less related to this sphere: what do you like to do? What do you do in life? What music do you listen to? What is your favourite dish?

I'll be waiting for you!

pro_course_detail.title: Ciao, come stai?
pro_course_detail.description:
L'italiano è una lingua molto affascinante, che ricalca la storia e la tradizione del Paese. 
Molti vogliono apprenderlo per poter passare delle splendide vacanze, godere delle bellezze del paese, e dell'ottimo cibo!
Prima, però, è necessario sapersi presentare!

Per questo vi invito a prenotare una lezione di prova, per capire quali sono i vostri obiettivi, il vostro livello di partenza, e le modalità più adatte allo scopo che volete raggiungere.

Non abbiate paura, la comunità italiana è sempre pronta ad accogliervi e sorridervi se farete un piccolo sforzo provando ad utilizzare anche poche parole.

Vi aspetto, ciao!
